title: Connect memory to detail, edit and return
head: Final receipt commit is the PR head; implementation_head identifies tested code.

github_recheck.parent_ci: All active checks successful; conditional checks skipped.
github_recheck.base_decision: Continue the unmerged D stack on its corrected D25 head, preserving the owner checkout and not claiming isolated D01 compatibility.

design_reference.inspection: Native Figma detail at 37/50 percent and UI35 handoff/coverage inspected in browser; screenshots retained.
design_reference.limits: Eight runtime combinations, not eight native exports or a pixel diff. UI35 itself does not certify runtime focus, interruption, frame rate or OS reduced motion.

activation.correction: Current F17 canCorrect=false is preserved. Existing legacy writer has no expectedRevision CAS; preflight comparison does not make it atomic. Integration owner must verify correction readiness and concurrent-write behavior before enabling writes.
host_requirements: Retain controllers per authenticated scope; retire on logout/replacement.
Use matching live/fixture ports and scope IDs, never fixture fallback.
Verify F17/F18/F19 deployment, canonical invalidation/reconnect, durable Forget receipts and restart suppression.

implementation: Sentence transfer without scaling text, subordinate source/use/history, explicit correction/confirmation.
Stable assertion/action/note geometry and reserved feedback preserve the editor through conflicts; draft retained, reload required.
Canonical route correction follows replacement identity and retains provenance, including isolated SQLite reopen verification.
F19 local scope confirmation, distinct prepared digest, request identity and receipt recovery without automatic replay.
Stream invalidation before possible effects; query/window/scroll/focus restoration to replacement, origin or nearest surviving row.
Abort/generation guards and access/history failures purge stale content.

verification.command: bunx prettier --check ui/src/brief/memory/detail ui/src/brief/memory/stream/controller.ts docs/brief-delivery/D-26.md docs/brief-delivery/D-26.json docs/brief-delivery/evidence/D-26/browser-checks.json

commit_hooks.note: Normal hooks required; no bypass or OpenAI/ChatGPT coauthor trailer.

browser.method: CUA in-app Chromium interaction and read-only DOM geometry
observed: Canonical detail identity, edit cancellation, correction and earlier-value history.
Chat draft continuity across settled shell layouts, no horizontal overflow.
Conflict controls have identical before/after coordinates at desktop and 390px after observed jumps were fixed.
100 loaded rows: Forget of 080 returns to 081 at identical offset/scroll at desktop and 390px.
Source-changing correction preserves Search and Source and returns focus to Search when the replacement no longer matches.
Unknown Forget clears content and recovers via receipt read.
Long content wraps at 390px; keyboard Tab reaches Confirm fact.
Forward sentence transfer observed at entry (372.104,380.097) and settled (270,307).

not_run: Live authenticated F17/F18/F19 deployment and real Forget
Atomic correction CAS (not supported by the legacy route)
Native OS reduced-motion setting; media-query behavior and interrupted return cancellation have React tests
Frame-rate certification, rapid repeated interruption and velocity continuity
Full repository local test suite; GitHub CI reported separately

preview.isolation: Loopback static fixture server, no daemon, API proxy or user vault.

rollback: Remove optional room registration or switch the host view gate to the legacy UI; revert card commits if needed. No migration/data reversal or effect replay.
private_progress: Updated outside product repository; shared Drive roadmap unchanged.
